## Data Preprocessing

### (1) Load raw data

```{r}
data_raw_births <- read.csv(paste0(DIR_DATA, "S1Data_granular_covars.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
data_raw_deaths <- read.csv(paste0(DIR_DATA, "S1Data_deaths_covars.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

cat(glue("
Summary of raw data:
- Births data summary:
  - Number of rows: {nrow(data_raw_births)}
  - Number of distinct municipalities: {n_distinct(data_raw_births$dom_comuna)}
- Deaths data summary:
  - Number of rows: {nrow(data_raw_deaths)}
  - Number of distinct municipalities: {n_distinct(data_raw_deaths$dom_comuna)}
\n"))
```

### (2) Data processing: Aggregate granular data into a municipality x year panel

Data structure after aggregation: - Identifiers: dom_comuna, year - Key Variables:

```         
- `popln`: Population within the age range
- `births`: Number of births within the age range
- `pill`: Indicator for pill usage
- `pilldistance`: Distance to the nearest pill distribution point
- `early_deaths`: Number of early deaths within the age range
- `birth_rate`: Birth rate per 1000 women
- `death_rate`: Early death rate per 1000 live births
- `trend`: Linear time trend within each municipality
- `close10`: Indicator for being close to the nearest treated municipality within 10 km (requires pill == 0)
- `close20`: Indicator for being close to the nearest treated municipality within 10-20 km (requires pill == 0)
- `close30`: Indicator for being close to the nearest treated municipality within 20-30 km (requires pill == 0)
- `first_treat`: First year municipality has pill == 1 (0 if never treated)
- `is_switcher`: Indicator for whether pill reverts from 1 to 0 at any point
- `is_spillover`: Indicator for never-treated municipalities close to a treated one
```

- Covariates:

  - `X_party_` Series: Dummy variables for the mayor's political party
  - `X_mujer`: Indicator for whether the mayor is female
  - `X_votop`: The mayor's vote share/margin
  - `X_outofschool`: Percentage of girls out of high school
  - `X_educationspend`: Total education spending
  - `X_educationmunicip`: Municipal-level education spending
  - `X_healthspend`: Total health spending
  - `X_healthtraining`: Health worker training spending
  - `X_healthstaff`: Health staffing spending
  - `X_femalepoverty`: Percentage of female-headed households below the poverty line
  - `X_femaleworkers`: Percentage of female workers in professional/public positions
  - `X_condom`: Condom availability/usage rate (regional level)

```{r}
# Covariates:
X_cols <- c(
  "party", "mujer", "votop",                           # Mayor-related variables
  "outofschool", "educationspend", "educationmunicip", # Education-related variables
  "healthspend", "healthtraining", "healthstaff",      # Health-related variables
  "femalepoverty", "femaleworkers",                    # Female-related variables
  "condom"                                             # Contraceptive use
)
```

```{r}
# Function to prepare model data for a specific age range
get_model_data <- function(age_lo, age_hi) {

  # Aggregate births data by municipality and year
  agg_births <- data_raw_births |>
    filter(age >= age_lo, age <= age_hi) |>
    group_by(dom_comuna, year) |>
    summarise(
      popln        = sum(n, na.rm = TRUE),
      births       = sum(n[pregnant == 1], na.rm = TRUE),
      pill         = first(pill),
      pilldistance = first(pilldistance),
      across(all_of(X_cols), ~first(.x)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # Create dummy variables for the mayor's political party -- the only categorical covariate
  for (lv in sort(unique(agg_births$party))) {
    agg_births[[paste0("X_party_", lv)]] <- as.integer(agg_births$party == lv)
  }

  agg_births <- agg_births |>
    select(-party) |>
    rename_with(~ paste0("X_", .x), .cols = setdiff(X_cols, "party"))

  # Aggregate deaths data by municipality and year
  agg_deaths <- data_raw_deaths |>
    filter(age >= age_lo, age <= age_hi) |>
    group_by(dom_comuna, year) |>
    summarise(
      early_deaths = sum(earlyP, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # Aggregate combined data by municipality and year
  agg_combine <- agg_births |> inner_join(agg_deaths, by = c("dom_comuna", "year")) |>
    arrange(dom_comuna, year) |>
    group_by(dom_comuna) |>
    mutate(trend = year - min(year)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(
      birth_rate = (births / popln) * 1000,
      death_rate = (early_deaths / births) * 1000,
      dom_comuna = factor(dom_comuna),
      close10 = as.integer(pill == 0 & pilldistance >  0 & pilldistance <= 10),
      close20 = as.integer(pill == 0 & pilldistance > 10 & pilldistance <= 20),
      close30 = as.integer(pill == 0 & pilldistance > 20 & pilldistance <= 30)
    ) |>
    relocate(starts_with("X_"), .after = last_col())

  # Construct municipality-level derived variables: first_treat, is_switcher, is_spillover
  treatment_flags <- agg_combine |>
    arrange(dom_comuna, year) |>
    group_by(dom_comuna) |>
    summarise(
      first_treat  = if (any(pill == 1)) min(year[pill == 1]) else 0,
      is_switcher  = as.integer(any(diff(pill) == -1)),
      is_spillover = as.integer(all(pill == 0) & any(close10 == 1 | close20 == 1 | close30 == 1)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  agg_combine <- agg_combine |> left_join(treatment_flags, by = "dom_comuna")

  return(agg_combine)
}
```

### (3) Summary Statistics

```{r}
# Function to compute descriptive statistics for one age group
get_summary_stats <- function(df, label) {
  flags <- df |> distinct(dom_comuna, first_treat, is_switcher, is_spillover)

  tibble(
    age_group            = label,
    n_municipalities     = n_distinct(df$dom_comuna),
    n_obs                = nrow(df),
    popln_mean           = mean(df$popln, na.rm = TRUE),
    popln_sd             = sd(df$popln, na.rm = TRUE),
    birth_rate_mean      = mean(df$birth_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    birth_rate_sd        = sd(df$birth_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    death_rate_mean      = mean(df$death_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    death_rate_sd        = sd(df$death_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    pill_share           = mean(df$pill, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_never_treated      = sum(flags$first_treat == 0),
    n_treated            = sum(flags$first_treat > 0),
    first_treat_min      = min(flags$first_treat[flags$first_treat > 0]),
    first_treat_max      = max(flags$first_treat[flags$first_treat > 0]),
    n_treat_cohorts      = n_distinct(flags$first_treat[flags$first_treat > 0]),
    n_switchers          = sum(flags$is_switcher),
    n_spillover_excluded = sum(flags$is_spillover)
  )
}

summary_stats <- bind_rows(
  get_summary_stats(data_age1, "All Women (15-49)"),
  get_summary_stats(data_age2, "Teens (15-19)"),
  get_summary_stats(data_age3, "Young Adults (20-34)")
)

write.csv(summary_stats, paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_data_summary_stats.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n===== Descriptive Statistics by Age Group =====\n")
summary_stats
```

## Stage 1: TWFE Replication + De Chaisemartin & D'Haultfoeuille (2020) Diagnostic

### (1) Stage 1 Task 1: TWFE Replication

```{r}
# Function to compute standard errors: wild cluster bootstrap, falling back to cluster-robust (CRV1)
run_boottest <- function(model, param, cluster_var, spec_name) {

  # Try to run the wild cluster bootstrap first
  boot_obj <- tryCatch(
    {
      # boottest() draws its bootstrap weights via dqrng, which ignores R's set.seed(); seed it directly
      dqrng::dqset.seed(2727)

      # Swallow boottest()'s own printed diagnostics (not caught by suppressWarnings/Messages)
      invisible(capture.output(
        boot_result <- suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(
          boottest(model, param = param, clustid = cluster_var, B = 999, nthreads = 1)
        ))
      ))

      boot_result
    },
    
    error = function(e) {
      cat(glue("[{spec_name}] failed to run wild cluster bootstrap({conditionMessage(e)}), and change to cluster-robust(CRV1) standard errors\n"))
      return(NULL)
    }
  )

  # If the wild cluster bootstrap does not fail, extract the results and format them into a tibble
  if (!is.null(boot_obj)) {
    bt <- broom::tidy(boot_obj)  

    result <- tibble(
      coef      = bt$estimate[1],
      se        = bt$estimate[1] / bt$statistic[1],
      p_value   = bt$p.value[1],
      ci_lower  = bt$conf.low[1],
      ci_upper  = bt$conf.high[1],
      se_method = "wild_cluster_bootstrap"
    )
  }
  # If the wild cluster bootstrap fails, fall back to cluster-robust standard errors (CRV1)
  else {
    s  <- summary(model, cluster = cluster_var)
    ct <- s$coeftable[param, ]
    ci <- confint(s)[param, ]
    result <- tibble(
      coef      = unname(ct[["Estimate"]]),
      se        = unname(ct[["Std. Error"]]),
      p_value   = unname(ct[["Pr(>|t|)"]]),
      ci_lower  = unname(ci[[1]]),
      ci_upper  = unname(ci[[2]]),
      se_method = "cluster_robust_CRV1_fallback"
    )
  }

  return(result)
}
```

```{r}
# Function to run TWFE regression with optional population weighting and wild cluster bootstrap for standard errors
run_twfe <- function(df, outcome, model_spec, baseline_only = FALSE) {

  # Data for the model
  df <- df |>
    filter(is.finite(.data[[outcome]])) |>
    group_by(dom_comuna) |>
    filter(n() > 1) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(dom_comuna = droplevels(dom_comuna))

  set.seed(2727)  # Base R seed; boottest()'s own draws are seeded separately (see run_boottest())

  # Function to extract results from a model using wild cluster bootstrap
  extract <- function(model, spec_name) {
    run_boottest(model, "pill", "dom_comuna", spec_name) |>
      mutate(
        model_spec  = model_spec,
        outcome     = outcome,
        spec        = spec_name,
        n_obs       = nobs(model),
        n_municipal = n_distinct(df$dom_comuna),
        .before = 1
      )
  }

  # Baseline model, following Table 4 column (1) of Bentancor and Clarke (2017)
  f_base <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ pill | dom_comuna + year"))
  m_base <- feols(f_base, data = df)

  # Skip the other two specifications if only the baseline is needed (e.g. for the restricted sample)
  if (baseline_only) {
    return(extract(m_base, "baseline_TWFE"))
  }

  # Remaining two formulas, following Table 4 column (2) and Table 5 column (3) of Bentancor and Clarke (2017)
  f_trend <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ pill + i(dom_comuna, trend) | dom_comuna + year"))

  m_trend   <- feols(f_trend, data = df)
  m_base_pw <- feols(f_base,  data = df, weights = ~popln)

  # Run the extraction function on each of the three TWFE models
  result <- bind_rows(
    extract(m_base,    "baseline_TWFE"),
    extract(m_trend,   "TWFE_with_trends"),
    extract(m_base_pw, "baseline_popln_weighted")
  )

  return(result)
}
```

```{r}
# Run the TWFE regressions for all 3 age groups and 2 outcomes (6 groups)
twfe_11 <- run_twfe(data_age1, "birth_rate", "Birth Rate & All Age")     |> mutate(age_group = "all_women",   .before = 1)
twfe_12 <- run_twfe(data_age1, "death_rate", "Death Rate & All Age")     |> mutate(age_group = "all_women",   .before = 1)
twfe_21 <- run_twfe(data_age2, "birth_rate", "Birth Rate & Teens")       |> mutate(age_group = "teens",       .before = 1)
twfe_22 <- run_twfe(data_age2, "death_rate", "Death Rate & Teens")       |> mutate(age_group = "teens",       .before = 1)
twfe_31 <- run_twfe(data_age3, "birth_rate", "Birth Rate & Young Adult") |> mutate(age_group = "young_adult", .before = 1)
twfe_32 <- run_twfe(data_age3, "death_rate", "Death Rate & Young Adult") |> mutate(age_group = "young_adult", .before = 1)

results_s1t1_twfe_origin <- bind_rows(twfe_11, twfe_12, twfe_21, twfe_22, twfe_31, twfe_32)
write.csv(results_s1t1_twfe_origin, paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_s1t1_twfe_origin.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n===== Stage 1 Task 1: Baseline TWFE Estimates (6 Groups) =====\n")
results_s1t1_twfe_origin |> filter(spec == "baseline_TWFE")
```

### (2) Stage 1 Task 2: De Chaisemartin & D'Haultfoeuille (2020) Diagnostics

```{r}
# Function to compute the De Chaisemartin & D'Haultfoeuille (2020) TWFE diagnostics
run_diagnostic <- function(df, outcome, model_spec) {
  
  # Data for the diagnostic function
  df <- df |>
    filter(is.finite(.data[[outcome]])) |>
    group_by(dom_comuna) |>
    filter(n() > 1) |>
    ungroup()

  # Diagnostic using TwoWayFEWeights
  diag <- TwoWayFEWeights::twowayfeweights(
    data              = as.data.frame(df),
    Y                 = outcome,
    G                 = "dom_comuna",
    T                 = "year",
    D                 = "pill",
    type              = "feTR",     # Use the "feTR" type for the TwoWayFEWeights diagnostic
    summary_measures  = TRUE        # Return summary measures for the diagnostic
  )

  # Summarize the diagnostic results into a tibble
  result <- tibble(
    model_spec     = model_spec,
    outcome        = outcome,
    sum_plus       = diag$sum_plus,                                  # Sum of positive weights
    sum_minus      = diag$sum_minus,                                 # Sum of negative weights
    share_negative = diag$nr_minus / (diag$nr_plus + diag$nr_minus), # Share of negative weights (by number of ATT(g,t) cells)
    min_sd_flip    = diag$sensibility,                               # Minimum treatment effect standard deviation (Corollary 1)
    n_obs          = nrow(df),
    n_municipal    = n_distinct(df$dom_comuna)
  )

  return(result)
}
```

```{r}
# Run the diagnostic function for all 3 age groups and 2 outcomes (6 groups)
diag_11 <- run_diagnostic(data_age1, "birth_rate", "Birth Rate & All Age")     |> mutate(age_group = "all_women",   .before = 1)
diag_12 <- run_diagnostic(data_age1, "death_rate", "Death Rate & All Age")     |> mutate(age_group = "all_women",   .before = 1)
diag_21 <- run_diagnostic(data_age2, "birth_rate", "Birth Rate & Teens")       |> mutate(age_group = "teens",       .before = 1)
diag_22 <- run_diagnostic(data_age2, "death_rate", "Death Rate & Teens")       |> mutate(age_group = "teens",       .before = 1)
diag_31 <- run_diagnostic(data_age3, "birth_rate", "Birth Rate & Young Adult") |> mutate(age_group = "young_adult", .before = 1)
diag_32 <- run_diagnostic(data_age3, "death_rate", "Death Rate & Young Adult") |> mutate(age_group = "young_adult", .before = 1)

results_s1t2_diagnostic <- bind_rows(diag_11, diag_12, diag_21, diag_22, diag_31, diag_32)
write.csv(results_s1t2_diagnostic,   paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_s1t2_diagnostic.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n===== Stage 1 Task 2: De Chaisemartin & D'Haultfoeuille Diagnostics =====\n")
results_s1t2_diagnostic
```

### (3) Stage 1 Task 3: Spillover Robustness Check

#### (a) Check 1: Regression Based

```{r}
# Function to run the baseline TWFE model plus close10/close20/close30 
run_twfe_close <- function(df, outcome, model_spec) {

  df <- df |>
    filter(is.finite(.data[[outcome]])) |>
    group_by(dom_comuna) |>
    filter(n() > 1) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(dom_comuna = droplevels(dom_comuna))

  set.seed(2727)

  f_close <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ pill + close10 + close20 + close30 | dom_comuna + year"))
  m_close <- feols(f_close, data = df)

  run_boottest(m_close, "pill", "dom_comuna", "TWFE_close_controls") |>
    mutate(
      model_spec  = model_spec,
      outcome     = outcome,
      spec        = "TWFE_close_controls",
      n_obs       = nobs(m_close),
      n_municipal = n_distinct(df$dom_comuna),
      .before = 1
    )
}
```

```{r}
# Run the close-controls TWFE regression for all 3 age groups and 2 outcomes (6 groups), on the full (unrestricted) sample
close_11 <- run_twfe_close(data_age1, "birth_rate", "Birth Rate & All Age")     |> mutate(age_group = "all_women",   .before = 1)
close_12 <- run_twfe_close(data_age1, "death_rate", "Death Rate & All Age")     |> mutate(age_group = "all_women",   .before = 1)
close_21 <- run_twfe_close(data_age2, "birth_rate", "Birth Rate & Teens")       |> mutate(age_group = "teens",       .before = 1)
close_22 <- run_twfe_close(data_age2, "death_rate", "Death Rate & Teens")       |> mutate(age_group = "teens",       .before = 1)
close_31 <- run_twfe_close(data_age3, "birth_rate", "Birth Rate & Young Adult") |> mutate(age_group = "young_adult", .before = 1)
close_32 <- run_twfe_close(data_age3, "death_rate", "Death Rate & Young Adult") |> mutate(age_group = "young_adult", .before = 1)

results_s1t3a_spillover_close <- bind_rows(close_11, close_12, close_21, close_22, close_31, close_32)
write.csv(results_s1t3a_spillover_close, paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_s1t3a_spillover_close.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n===== Stage 1 Task 3, Check 1: TWFE with Close Controls, Full Sample (6 Groups) =====\n")
results_s1t3a_spillover_close
```

#### (b) Check 2: Sample Restriction Based

```{r}
# Function to remove municipalities flagged as spillover-contaminated
remove_spillover_contaminated <- function(panel, age_group) {
  n_excl  <- panel |> distinct(dom_comuna, is_spillover) |> pull(is_spillover) |> sum()
  n_total <- n_distinct(panel$dom_comuna)

  cat(glue("
  [{age_group}] Identified {n_excl}/{n_total} never-treated municipalities close to a treated municipality; {n_total - n_excl} remain in the restricted sample.
  \n"))

  panel |> filter(is_spillover == 0)
}
```

```{r}
# Apply to all 3 age groups to get spillover-excluded restricted data
data_age1_sp <- remove_spillover_contaminated(data_age1, "All Women")
data_age2_sp <- remove_spillover_contaminated(data_age2, "Teens")
data_age3_sp <- remove_spillover_contaminated(data_age3, "Young Adults")
```

```{r}
# Check 2: Run the baseline TWFE regression on the spillover-excluded restricted data
twfe_sp_11 <- run_twfe(data_age1_sp, "birth_rate", "Birth Rate & All Age")     |> mutate(age_group = "all_women",   .before = 1)
twfe_sp_12 <- run_twfe(data_age1_sp, "death_rate", "Death Rate & All Age")     |> mutate(age_group = "all_women",   .before = 1)
twfe_sp_21 <- run_twfe(data_age2_sp, "birth_rate", "Birth Rate & Teens")       |> mutate(age_group = "teens",       .before = 1)
twfe_sp_22 <- run_twfe(data_age2_sp, "death_rate", "Death Rate & Teens")       |> mutate(age_group = "teens",       .before = 1)
twfe_sp_31 <- run_twfe(data_age3_sp, "birth_rate", "Birth Rate & Young Adult") |> mutate(age_group = "young_adult", .before = 1)
twfe_sp_32 <- run_twfe(data_age3_sp, "death_rate", "Death Rate & Young Adult") |> mutate(age_group = "young_adult", .before = 1)

# Only the baseline specification is needed for this robustness check
results_s1t3b_spillover_excluded <- 
  bind_rows(twfe_sp_11, twfe_sp_12, twfe_sp_21, twfe_sp_22, twfe_sp_31, twfe_sp_32) |>
  filter(spec == "baseline_TWFE")

write.csv(results_s1t3b_spillover_excluded, paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_s1t3b_spillover_excluded.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n===== Stage 1 Task 3, Check 2: TWFE on Spillover-Excluded Restricted Sample (6 Groups) =====\n")
```

## Stage 2: DID using Callaway & Sant'Anna (2021) Methods

### (1) Stage 2 Task 1: TWFE Estimation on Switcher-Excluded Restricted Sample

```{r}
# Function to remove municipalities flagged as switchers
remove_switchers <- function(panel, age_group) {
  n_switch <- panel |> distinct(dom_comuna, is_switcher) |> pull(is_switcher) |> sum()
  n_total  <- n_distinct(panel$dom_comuna)

  cat(glue("
  [{age_group}] Identified {n_switch}/{n_total} switcher municipalities; {n_total - n_switch} remain in the restricted sample.
  \n"))

  panel |> filter(is_switcher == 0)
}
```

```{r}
# Apply to all 3 age groups to get switcher-excluded restricted data
data_age1_ns <- remove_switchers(data_age1, "All Women")
data_age2_ns <- remove_switchers(data_age2, "Teens")
data_age3_ns <- remove_switchers(data_age3, "Young Adults")
```

```{r}
# Run only the baseline TWFE specification on the switcher-excluded restricted data
twfe_ns_11 <- run_twfe(data_age1_ns, "birth_rate", "Birth Rate & All Age",     baseline_only = TRUE) |> mutate(age_group = "all_women",   .before = 1)
twfe_ns_12 <- run_twfe(data_age1_ns, "death_rate", "Death Rate & All Age",     baseline_only = TRUE) |> mutate(age_group = "all_women",   .before = 1)
twfe_ns_21 <- run_twfe(data_age2_ns, "birth_rate", "Birth Rate & Teens",       baseline_only = TRUE) |> mutate(age_group = "teens",       .before = 1)
twfe_ns_22 <- run_twfe(data_age2_ns, "death_rate", "Death Rate & Teens",       baseline_only = TRUE) |> mutate(age_group = "teens",       .before = 1)
twfe_ns_31 <- run_twfe(data_age3_ns, "birth_rate", "Birth Rate & Young Adult", baseline_only = TRUE) |> mutate(age_group = "young_adult", .before = 1)
twfe_ns_32 <- run_twfe(data_age3_ns, "death_rate", "Death Rate & Young Adult", baseline_only = TRUE) |> mutate(age_group = "young_adult", .before = 1)

results_s2t1_twfe_ns <- bind_rows(twfe_ns_11, twfe_ns_12, twfe_ns_21, twfe_ns_22, twfe_ns_31, twfe_ns_32)

write.csv(results_s2t1_twfe_ns, paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_s2t1_twfe_ns.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

```

### (2) Stage 2 Task 2: Callaway & Sant'Anna (2021) Estimation

```{r}
# Add a numeric municipality id (required by the did package)
add_id_num <- function(panel) {
  panel |> mutate(id_num = as.integer(factor(dom_comuna)))
}
```

```{r}
# Function to run the Callaway & Sant'Anna (2021)
run_cs <- function(panel, outcome, age_group, control_group = "nevertreated", weights_col = NULL) {

  # Add a numeric municipality id (required by the did package)
  dat <- add_id_num(panel)

  # Set the random seed for reproducibility of the bootstrap procedure
  set.seed(2727)

  # Run the Callaway & Sant'Anna (2021) estimator on the prepared panel data
  invisible(capture.output(
    att <- suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(att_gt(
      yname                  = outcome,
      tname                  = "year",
      idname                 = "id_num",
      gname                  = "first_treat",
      xformla                = ~1,               # No covariates: TWFE with regressors can be severely biased
      data                   = as.data.frame(dat),
      control_group          = control_group,
      weightsname            = weights_col,       # NULL = unconditional (main spec), "popln" = weighted robustness check
      allow_unbalanced_panel = TRUE,
      clustervars            = "id_num",
      bstrap                 = TRUE,
      biters                 = 1000,
      base_period            = "varying"
    )))
  ))

  # Aggregate the ATT estimates using the "simple" method
  simple_agg <- aggte(att, type = "simple")

  # Compute the p-value for the overall ATT estimate using a normal approximation
  p_value <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(simple_agg$overall.att / simple_agg$overall.se))

  # Label as unconditional or population-weighted, mirroring the TWFE specifications
  spec_name <- if (is.null(weights_col)) "unconditional" else paste0(weights_col, "_weighted")

  result <- list(
    att_gt     = att,
    simple     = simple_agg,
    dynamic    = aggte(att, type = "dynamic"),
    group      = aggte(att, type = "group"),
    simple_row = tibble(
      age_group   = age_group, 
      outcome     = outcome,
      spec        = spec_name,
      coef        = simple_agg$overall.att, 
      se          = simple_agg$overall.se,
      p_value     = p_value,
      n_obs       = sum(is.finite(dat[[outcome]])),  # Valid municipality-year observations for this outcome
      n_municipal = att$n                            # Municipalities actually used by att_gt (unbalanced-panel aware)
    )
  )
  
  return(result)
}
```

```{r}
# Run the Callaway & Sant'Anna estimation for all 3 age groups and 2 outcomes (6 groups),
cs_11 <- run_cs(data_age1_ns, "birth_rate", "all_women")
cs_12 <- run_cs(data_age1_ns, "death_rate", "all_women")
cs_21 <- run_cs(data_age2_ns, "birth_rate", "teens")
cs_22 <- run_cs(data_age2_ns, "death_rate", "teens")
cs_31 <- run_cs(data_age3_ns, "birth_rate", "young_adult")
cs_32 <- run_cs(data_age3_ns, "death_rate", "young_adult")

cs_11_pw <- run_cs(data_age1_ns, "birth_rate", "all_women",   weights_col = "popln")
cs_12_pw <- run_cs(data_age1_ns, "death_rate", "all_women",   weights_col = "popln")
cs_21_pw <- run_cs(data_age2_ns, "birth_rate", "teens",       weights_col = "popln")
cs_22_pw <- run_cs(data_age2_ns, "death_rate", "teens",       weights_col = "popln")
cs_31_pw <- run_cs(data_age3_ns, "birth_rate", "young_adult", weights_col = "popln")
cs_32_pw <- run_cs(data_age3_ns, "death_rate", "young_adult", weights_col = "popln")

results_s2t2_cs <- bind_rows(
  cs_11$simple_row, cs_12$simple_row,
  cs_21$simple_row, cs_22$simple_row,
  cs_31$simple_row, cs_32$simple_row,
  cs_11_pw$simple_row, cs_12_pw$simple_row,
  cs_21_pw$simple_row, cs_22_pw$simple_row,
  cs_31_pw$simple_row, cs_32_pw$simple_row
)

write.csv(results_s2t2_cs, paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_s2t2_cs.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n===== Stage 2 Task 2: Callaway & Sant'Anna (2021) Estimates (6 Groups) =====\n")
results_s2t2_cs
```

### (3) Stage 2 Task 3: Pre-treatment Dynamic Effects (Placebo-style Pre-trends Check)

```{r}
# Extract pre-treatment (e<0) dynamic effects as a "placebo-style" pre-trends check
extract_pretrends <- function(cs_obj, age_group, outcome) {
  # Extract the dynamic ATT estimates from the Callaway & Sant'Anna (2021) object
  d <- cs_obj$dynamic
  
  # Create a tibble with the relevant dynamic ATT estimates and their standard errors
  result <- 
    tibble(
      age_group  = age_group,
      outcome    = outcome,
      event_time = d$egt,
      att        = d$att.egt,
      se         = d$se.egt,
      crit_val   = d$crit.val.egt
    ) |>
    filter(event_time < 0) |>
    mutate(
      # Pointwise p-value from a normal approximation
      p_value     = 2 * pnorm(-abs(att / se)),
      sig_at_5pct = abs(att / se) > crit_val,
      # Same N as the overall ATT for this age group/outcome (same underlying att_gt object)
      n_obs       = cs_obj$simple_row$n_obs,
      n_municipal = cs_obj$simple_row$n_municipal
    )
  
  return(result)
}
```

```{r}
# Apply the function to all relevant Callaway & Sant'Anna (2021) objects and combine the results
results_s2t3_pretrends <- bind_rows(
  extract_pretrends(cs_11, "all_women",   "birth_rate"),
  extract_pretrends(cs_12, "all_women",   "death_rate"),
  extract_pretrends(cs_21, "teens",       "birth_rate"),
  extract_pretrends(cs_22, "teens",       "death_rate"),
  extract_pretrends(cs_31, "young_adult", "birth_rate"),
  extract_pretrends(cs_32, "young_adult", "death_rate")
)

write.csv(results_s2t3_pretrends, paste0(DIR_OUT, "results_s2t3_pretrends.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n===== Stage 2 Task 3: Pre-treatment Dynamic Effects (Placebo-style Pre-trends Check) =====\n")
results_s2t3_pretrends
```

```{r}
# Build overall comparison table
result_overall_comparison <- results_s1t1_twfe_origin |>
  filter(spec == "baseline_TWFE") |>
  select(age_group, outcome, TWFE_full_coef = coef, TWFE_full_se = se, TWFE_full_pvalue = p_value) |>
  left_join(
    results_s2t1_twfe_ns |>
      filter(spec == "baseline_TWFE") |>
      select(age_group, outcome, TWFE_restricted_coef = coef, TWFE_restricted_se = se, TWFE_restricted_pvalue = p_value),
    by = c("age_group", "outcome")
  ) |>
  left_join(
    results_s2t2_cs |>
      filter(spec == "unconditional") |>
      select(age_group, outcome, CS_restricted_coef = coef, CS_restricted_se = se, CS_restricted_pvalue = p_value),
    by = c("age_group", "outcome")
  )

write.csv(result_overall_comparison, paste0(DIR_OUT, "result_overall_comparison.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
